findings.passage: The Constitution of the United States clearly leaves the power to manage elections to the States. This is just another sneaky attempt by tyrants to centralize power in D.C. so they can control the outcome. We already have the Constitution; all we need to do is follow it.
findings.note: Her written answer on the Arizona Voter Guide survey to question 8, 'Federalizing election law by removing state authority over elections.' She marked it as opposed. Page last-updated date used as the date. It does not mention ID or citizenship proof, but it bears on who sets election rules such as ID requirements.
